notes.title: NotiVR Redesign Launch
notes.content:
We've just launched the biggest ever update to NotiVR (aside from the name change of course)

Yesterday we announced our name change from PhoneLink VR to NotiVR. Today we're lauching the much anticipated redesign!

This update should be pretty smooth, all of your settings and paired devices will work like they did before the update. Keep in mind that this is still early access software, if you have any issues you can revert back to the 'legacy' branch and experience the pre-update PhoneLink VR app.

NOTE: If you're using the redesign-preview branch make sure you switch back to the default branch

Note you may need to restart your Steam client to see the name change and the new update.

Anyway here's the patch notes!


 Complete rewrite of the desktop app
 Updated UI design to match our Android app
 Improved first time setup experience
 XSOverlay notifications support (requires XSOverlay to be installed and running)
 A new VR overlay with matching design
 Steam Cloud settings sync
 Rebranded app from PhoneLink VR to NotiVR


This has been a huge undertaking for the team at Matterworks and we're so excited to finally be sharing this with you all! But this is only the start, our new tech stack lays the groundwork for many exciting new updates. Keep you're eyes on our Steam news feed and Twitter for more announcements.

We'd finally like to thank all of the beta testers who helped get this update out the door. Extra special thanks to beta testers Moose and Puffs.

See you soon!

notes.title: Redesign Preview Hotfix
notes.content:
This hotfix updates the port detection logic to fix port collisions after reboot.

If you've had an issue with PhoneLink VR crashing on launch please remove the HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Matterworks Interactive\PhoneLink VR registry key

notes.title: Preview the next version of PhoneLink VR
notes.content:
The PhoneLink VR redesign preview is now available!

TL;DR

Head over to PhoneLink VR's properties in Steam, go to the beta tab and select "redesign-preview". Let PhoneLink VR update and enjoy! (you may need to restart Steam if you don't see the option).

We can't wait to hear what you have to think about our new look in the comments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41425010/f3e8722f963a2e01139226f8a33ecc6f5716ae6f.png

The longer bit

If you've been keeping up with our devlogs we've been working on a new version of PhoneLink VR for quite a while. The old app wasn't the best in terms of design, so we've taken the time to rebuild the app from the ground up.

This has been a massive undertaking and we're almost finished! However we need your help to make the new version of PhoneLink VR the best it can be.

We'll be replacing the old PhoneLink VR client with this new version very soon but we're giving our users an opportunity to preview the changes and help provide feedback before we go live. All you have to do is follow the instructions above, try the changes out and give us feedback in the comments.

notes.title: PhoneLink VR Devlog 2
notes.content:
Hello again!

Welcome to the second devlog for PhoneLink VR. We're still hard at work on our redesign, here's some of the highlights from the last few weeks. We'll be launching a beta version of the redesign to get some feedback from the community. A few select members of the community have been previewing a closed beta over the last few days and so far feedback has been pretty positive!

New setup experience

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41425010/b1faf2803fae7c7d41c05089c03d006b32db7c7e.gif

The setup flow in the original app wasn't the best, there was a lot of text and it can be quite overwhelming for new users. We've redesigned the setup experience and updated some of the language to make it easier for new users to understand. There's still more we're looking to do with setup. We're looking into ways to reduce the number of QR codes that need scanning but don't have anything to share just yet.

XSOverlay integration

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41425010/faf0a98e958adb4024a24a37123a7568c323522a.gif

Since devlog 1 we've worked hard on the XSOverlay integration. Our first iteration of this is working great, just check "Use XSOverlay Notifications" in the desktop app and you'll now see your notifications appear using XSOverlay's system rather than SteamVR's.

Dashboard overlay

One of the technical benefits of our redesign is the new UI system we're using. The old app used Qt which worked fine for the first version of the app but was a pain to work with and iterate on. The new system is powered by Ultralight, which is a UI renderer designed for games. It integrates really well with the GPU which is great when you're working with SteamVR overlays.

We are able to reuse 90% of the code from the desktop UI in the dashboard overlay. Because of this we're hoping that adding new overlays will be much easier in the future. For example, having an overlay attached to your wrist.

See you next time!

notes.title: PhoneLink VR Devlog 1
notes.content:
Happy Easter!

Welcome to the first Devlog for PhoneLink VR and we've got quite a lot to show you! First things first, I'd like to address the lack of updates and communication from us. We're an indie team of just 2 people and so we sadly can't spend all our time working on PhoneLink VR and other Matterworks projects.

Now that's not to say we've not been doing anything! We've released a number of updates to our Android app and have been working on the next major update for our desktop client.

Android
Since we launched back in November 2021 we've released 6 updates to our Android app. Most of our effort has been around improving the Android app experience. Here's some of the highlights

Quick settings tile
One complaint we had about the user experience is that having to open the PhoneLink VR app whenever you want to connect was a bit annoying. So we've added a quick setting tile that you can use to connect to your PC without having to open the app.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41425010/e6f64de2fa36006bff0b047cc1f491f6e3d2a33c.png

Reworked background service
Another major annoyance we've fixed is making sure PhoneLink VR stays open in the background. We initially set up the app to disconnect from your PC when you close the app, making it super easy to manage when you're connected. However we found that this resulted in an issue where your phone would sometimes kill the app and disconnect you to improve battery life.

We've adjusted how the app works in the background to make sure it stays connected for longer. While working on this improvement, we also updated the background notification to make is super easy to see the status and disconnect from your PC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41425010/3c63eee62325c76cee5f9ada01c71cfe28d06bc5.png

As well as a few small but important tweaks

Rebuilt our QR code scanner, some users on slower devices were having issues with this
Fixed duplication notifications occasionally being sent
Improved how we show network errors
Squashed a lot of bugs


Desktop

One area where there hasn't been a lot of visible work is our desktop app. Obviously this is an extremely important of PhoneLink VR and somewhere where we really want to improve the experience. A few months ago we made the tough decision to redesign the app from scratch. One of the main pieces of feedback we received was about the overall design of the app so that's one area we've really focused on with this new version.

Redesigned desktop app

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41425010/52d8740a68c966cc26e4cae667470485de6cc32d.png

This is a screenshot from our latest dev build of PhoneLink VR, the final product may not look exactly like this. The main improvement is a switch to a Material Design style for the desktop app, this now means that both the Android and desktop app will look visually similar. The new UI will also be brought over to the VR overlay, however we're not quite ready to show that off yet.

The new version of PhoneLink VR also brings some important technical changes for future updates. For example, we've switched to a new OpenGL based renderer rather than using Qt. This means we can add new VR overlays much easier than before. We're not ready to announce any new features yet but we're laying the groundwork for what's to come.

As mentioned this is still a work in progress, so if there's anything you'd like us to add or change please let us know we've love to hear it!

XSOverlay

Another big improvement you can see is the addition of XSOverlay notification support. By checking the XSOverlay box, PhoneLink VR will switch to using much nicer XS notification system rather than SteamVR's. If you're a heavy XSOverlay user this feature's for you!

Improved streamer mode

We're also taking the time to improve the streamer mode we shipped earlier last year. This mode is great for streamers who use the VR mirror instead of capturing games directly. We're currently experimenting with a wrist mounted overlay that shows your notification count instead of popping up notifications every time.

If you're a VR streamer and have any suggestions for improvements to this mode, please get in touch!

Desktop Beta

We don't have a release date for the new redesign just yet, however with such a huge update we plan to release it in stages. First with a closed alpha test which we plan to launch soon (if you're a PhoneLink VR power user and want access, please get in touch!), then we'll launch an open beta followed by the public release.

Make sure you're following PhoneLink VR on Steam and keep your eyes on our community page. We'll be posting more devlogs as we work on this update!

See you soon!

notes.title: PhoneLink VR: The Reply Update
notes.content:
Our first major update after launch adds a great new feature, the reply button. If your notification supports it, simply click on the reply button and a VR keyboard will appear. Just type out your message and click Done!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41425010/6c58d90b95b48380e59adc0a1fbe76dc3b51bd86.png

The dev team have certified a few apps as compatible, however this new feature should work with most Android apps that support in-line replies.

Certified apps:

Android Messages
Discord
Twitter
WhatsApp
Telegram


We've also added a few quality of life updates, such as the ability to hide the control panel on start up and the ability to select which IP to use when pairing. If you've been having issues pairing your phone please try the new IP selector on the pair screen.

Desktop patch notes

 Added actions to VR overlay (limited to reply only)
 Reply action: triggers a keyboard and sends response to phone
 Added setting to hide control panel on startup
 Allow user to select IP on pairing screen (if you're having network issues try adjusting this)
 Fixed existing device not disconnecting when another device paired
 Updated Steamworks SDK to 1.53


Android patch notes (0.5.0)

 App now adds action data to packets sent to desktop app
 Added support for receiving replies from desktop app
 Updated the notification detection to ignore duplicate notifications
 Rewrote icon encoder to fix crashes with large icons



The reply feature requires Android app version 0.5.0 and above and Android 7.0+ (Nougat). Check the Play Store to download the update

notes.title: Announcing Reply Support
notes.content:
Hope you're all enjoying PhoneLink VR! The last few days have been amazing for the team. As a new studio we weren't sure how people would react to this project.

We're ready to announce our first major post-launch update, The Reply Update.

We were originally planning on releasing this feature as part of a larger update however we see the demand for this feature and have prioritised its development.

The Reply Update will allow you to reply from within VR to certain notifications (basically anything with a reply button). PhoneLink VR already does a good job of keeping you informed while remaining in VR. But now you don't have to take your headset off to communicate with others.

The Reply Update will be releasing as a free update very soon. 

To stay up to date with PhoneLink VR updates:

 Follow @MatterworksDev on Twitter
 Join the Matterworks Discord server

notes.title: PhoneLink VR Early Access FAQs
notes.content:
With nearly a week to go until the early access release of PhoneLink VR, we've taken some time to answer some questions about PhoneLink VR. 

Does PhoneLink VR work with iPhones? 
Not at launch. PhoneLink VR currently only supports Android phones running Android 6.0 (Marshmallow) and above. However, we are looking into ways to support iOS users in a future version. This isn't a small task, iOS doesn't offer an easy way for apps to read your notification history. There's also an additional cost for us in terms of development hardware and app store fees. 

If iOS support is something you're interested in, please let us know in the comments and on our community hub. The more requests we get, the more we'll work towards adding iOS support. We'll post an update to our community hub when we have more to share on this. 

Can you reply to messages while in VR? 
We're aiming to add support for notification actions (i.e. replying) in a future early access version. We expect that this will be added before the full release. 

Can I see my notification history if I miss a notification? 
Yes, we have a custom SteamVR dashboard that currently shows your last 4 notifications. The desktop control panel can show your last 10 notifications. 

When will PhoneLink VR exit early access? 
We haven't got an exact date for when we plan to fully launch PhoneLink VR. We don't plan to stay in early access for more than a year. Early access gives us a chance to hear from you about what features you'd like to see in the full version. We'll post an announcement when we're planning on fully releasing. 

What do I do if I have an issue or PhoneLink VR stops working? 
Since we're still in early access there may be some bugs. If you have any issue with the Android app or SteamVR app please make a post in our bugs forum 

I have an idea for something you should add to PhoneLink VR, where can I post it? 
We have a community forum set up for feature requests. Post your ideas there, if they get enough support we'll work on adding them. 

If you have any more questions please ask them in the comments, we'll try to respond to as many as we can!
